summary: This bill amends the National Voter Registration Act of 1993 to require individuals to provide documentary proof of U.S. citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections and to present photo identification when casting a ballot in federal elections.

scores.thoughts: This bill is almost entirely focused on federal election administration, specifically by requiring proof of citizenship for voter registration and photo identification for voting. It also mandates processes for states to identify and remove non-citizens from voter rolls, which are significant changes to election procedures aimed at securing elections.
